periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, pointing downward toward the nasal bridge.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Teardrop-shaped with an elongated vertical axis, roughly 1.6 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the lower boundary of the patch extends significantly further from the center than the upper boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately 80% of the visible shoulder and upper torso height in the lateral view.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The distance between the inner margins of the ear patches is roughly 1.3 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae are uniformly rounded and semicircular.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-tan staining on the ventral fur across the abdominal and lower thoracic regions.
